summary: Executed full security regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_security.py against public backend (https://whs-safety-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api). 33/33 tests PASSED in 51.4s. All post-audit fixes are verified: SEC-001 registration role gating (workers/contractors free, Safety Officer/Supervisor require OFFICER_ACCESS_CODE=TK-SAFETY-2026, wrong code -> 403, invalid role -> falls back to Worker), SEC-002a LOTO release owner/privileged-only + status allowlist (invalid -> 422), SEC-002b incident status owner/privileged-only + status allowlist + 404 for missing id, SEC-003 file ACL with '..' and non 'tk-safetyguard/' prefix rejected (400) and missing auth -> 401, assessment visibility (worker sees own only, officer sees all, worker cannot approve, officer can approve). Regression suite (health, auth/me, dashboard, LOTO, traffic, access sign-in/out, visitor, AI assess+photo persistence) all green.

minor.issue: PytestRemovedIn10Warning: two class-scoped fixtures (worker_assessment, worker_file_path) are defined as instance methods; move to @classmethod for pytest 10 compatibility. Non-blocking.

action_items: No functional action required. Security fixes are verified end-to-end.

critical_code_review_comments: Registration gate correctly rejects privileged roles without/with-wrong access_code (403) and downgrades unknown roles to Worker.
LOTO and Incident PATCH handlers correctly enforce owner-or-privileged plus Pydantic/enum status allowlists (422 on invalid).
/api/files enforces prefix 'tk-safetyguard/' and rejects '..' traversal (400) and returns 401 on missing bearer.
Assessments list/detail correctly scoped: workers see own only (leaked_id assertion passes), officers see all; approve gated to privileged.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway users TEST_worker*, TEST_officer*, TEST_sup*, TEST_contractor*, TEST_bogus*, TEST_worker2_* were created via /auth/register. LOTO/incidents/traffic/visitor rows and two AI assessments were created; all prefixed 'TEST_' for identification. No cleanup implemented in suite (records persist in test_database).
